top_strength: Nicole gathered comprehensive logistics details (storage fullness, floor access, distance measurements, property layout) and delivered a detailed, anchored pricing estimate with full fee transparency and promise explanations.
coaching_note: Section 2 concern follow-up was one-question shallow (ask about fullness, move on; ask about heavy items, move on) rather than two layers deep on the customer's stated core concern about 'how we go about that process' — and no reflection back at the end; Section 4 missing 'Does that feel fair?' pause; Section 6 final check was generic 'any questions' throwaway; Section 7 lacked rate-lock mention and allowed an easy email-and-think-about-it out instead of pushing for commitment.
